usage.callShape: GET https://twitter.surf.cascade.fyi/tweets?ids=<tweetId>[,<tweetId>...] (no body; one or more tweet IDs as a comma-separated `ids` query param). x402 pay ~$0.004 USDC (Base or Solana).
usage.outputShape: body.data[] — array of tweet objects. Each: body.data[i].{id,url,text,created_at,lang,conversation_id,is_reply,is_quote,is_retweet,is_thread_start,content_type,time_ago}, body.data[i].author.{id,username,name,description,profile_image_url,verified,public_metrics{followers_count,following_count,tweet_count,like_count,media_count}}, body.data[i].public_metrics.{like_count,retweet_count,reply_count,quote_count,impression_count,bookmark_count}. Also body.meta.{result_count,has_next_page}.
quirks: inputSchema was null in registry — the /tweets route REQUIRES an `ids` query param (comma-separated tweet IDs); a bare GET /tweets would have no input and fail.
Batch fetch: pass multiple tweet IDs comma-separated, e.g. ?ids=20,1234... — body.data is an array, body.meta.result_count reflects how many resolved.
Result is synchronous under body.data[]; no job id / polling.
Payment settled on Base (eip155:8453); also accepts Solana per paymentAccepts. txHash not returned by qa-pay (confirmed:false) but status 200 with real data confirms success.
usage.guide: Fetch one or more tweets by ID with a plain GET to https://twitter.surf.cascade.fyi/tweets?ids=<id> — supply tweet IDs as a comma-separated `ids` query parameter (this is required; there is no JSON body and no API key). Pay the x402 quote (~$0.004 USDC on Base or Solana). Read the result synchronously from body.data[], an array of full tweet objects (text, timestamps, engagement metrics, and an embedded author profile with public_metrics); check body.meta.result_count to see how many IDs resolved. Note this is the batch-tweet route of the wider Surf Twitter/X service — sibling routes like /users/{username} cover profile lookup, and others cover timelines/replies/following.
